payload.title: Measure the base hyp-owner-grill text on fixtures A and B, 3 trials each, to find which of S1 to S6 recur
payload.body: Base arm: skills/hyp-owner-grill at 132cb8e (SKILL.md sha256 1aca7adc095acae5143efd0311274871e304468eb9de976c3b1ca1382bfa4326), 3 trials per fixture, Sonnet, 50 min and 20 calls each. score runs on each OUT_DIR; a Sonnet reviewer that ran no trial grades each rubric assertion from outputs/ under shuffled labels, its reply kept word for word; table reads it. Line n (1 to 6) holds on base when it passes in 2 of 3 trials on each fixture it names; entry Sn is then no skill defect and both candidates leave its text unchanged. No verdict.

why: OWED: test both rivals; the Goal says an entry whose line holds on base gets no text change, so the base runs first.

payload.observation: Six base trials under hyp-owner-grill-eval@1 ran to the stand-in's end (3 to 9 exchanges), cost_usd 1.02 to 1.75. Mechanical checks: a Goal with lines in every trial; l1 fails in base-a-1 (a store at the clone's top directory) and passes in the other five; l4 passes in all six. Not graded by a reviewer: in base-a-3 the grill listed the sandbox's recipe copy (its stand-in and cases files by name) and grepped issue-a.md there, so Drive's isolation leaks the eval. hyp-owner-grill-eval@2 denies those reads; the base is measured again under @2.

why: Measures of the first base run; its isolation leak moves every arm to @2.

payload.observation: Six base trials under @2 ended at the stand-in's end (4 to 6 exchanges). table, with a blind Sonnet review of the rubric assertions: fixture a passes l1 1/3, l2 3/3, l3 0/3, l4 2/3, l5 0/3; fixture b passes l1 3/3, l4 3/3, l5 3/3, l6 3/3. Median cost_usd a 1.3349, b 1.0794 (literal 4.0429, 3.4299). Lines 1, 3 and 5 fail on base, so S1, S3 and S5 are skill defects. Lines 2, 4 and 6 hold on base, so S2, S4 and S6 are no skill defect, and the candidates leave their text unchanged.

why: Base measure under @2: which of S1 to S6 recur decides what the candidates edit.
It cites the score records' stdout, not their command.json, so hyp cannot vouch for it; recorded again with the command records.
